backend/main.mo: Motoko canister with access control, user profiles, and CRUD operations for posts including media and timestamps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all major frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme variables and base styles supporting light/dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, post details, and admin within a shared layout.
Protects admin routes by checking admin status and showing loading or access-denied UI.
frontend/src/components/AllowlistManager: Admin tool to grant, revoke, and check access permissions for principal IDs.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Application layout with theming, top navigation, footer, and toast provider.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Displays an error state with retry support for failed async operations.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button that triggers Internet Identity login/logout and shows corresponding UI states.
frontend/src/components/MediaGallery.tsx: Displays attached images or videos in a card-based gallery layout.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploader.ts: Handles selecting, uploading, and tracking progress of image or video files for a post.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Top navigation bar with home/admin links, mobile menu, and authentication button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks whether the current authenticated user is an admin using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, login/logout handling, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actions for posts, access control, media, and user-specific data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for light/dark modes with typography and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for listing, creating, editing, deleting, and timestamp-updating posts with form validation and dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Public homepage that lists posts, handles loading/error states, and shows admin-only entry points for creating posts.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single post with locked-content handling, authentication checks, and media display.
frontend/src/utils/date.ts: Formats Unix timestamps into Australia/Sydney human-readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/principal.ts: Validates Dfinity principal IDs and returns parsed results or errors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with typography, container queries, animations, and custom theme extensions.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, including its goals for a single-author journaling site with gated content, architectural notes on access control and timestamp handling, and a list of known bugs and existing implemented features. Provides context for migrations, time-zone issues, and functionality such as media attachments and paywalled posts.
